column1: # Phrases that are NOT a report for this kind of product (rules pc3; read by product_category.py).
# Columns, separated by TABS: term | label | unless | reason | when
#   term    regular expression that must match the whole flagged phrase
#   label   quality, defect, counterfeit, safety or not_as_described
#   unless  optional regular expression, matched as whole words; if a word within 3 words either side of the phrase matches, the exception is cancelled
#   reason  shown in the audit trail
#   when    optional regular expression, matched as whole words; the exception applies ONLY when one of the 3 words either side matches it
# A file named group_<group>.tsv applies to every category of the group. Restart the server after editing.
